findings.evidence: Basic.lean:113 declares `[NormedSpace ℂ V]`, and Basic.lean:521 adds `variable [CompleteSpace V] [CompleteSpace W]` before `quantizeSchwartzValue_kernelCutoff` (line 528). The proof body never mentions `inner`.
findings.fix: Move the lemma into `ProperSupport/Basic.lean` next to `quantizeSchwartzValue_kernelCutoff_eq_zero` (line 598), stated with `[NormedSpace ℂ V] [NormedSpace ℂ W] [CompleteSpace V] [CompleteSpace W]`.
findings.issue: `HasNearDiagonalKernel.quantizeSchwartzValue_kernelCutoff_eq` inherits `[InnerProductSpace ℂ V] [InnerProductSpace ℂ W]` from `section NativeTests`. Its proof uses only `quantizeSchwartzValue_kernelCutoff`, `hasPropagationLE_iff` and `quantizeSchwartzValue_congr`, which need just `NormedSpace ℂ` plus `CompleteSpace`.

findings.evidence: The proof body only takes real parts of inner products through `RCLike` API (`rw [← integral_re ...]`, `simpa only [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, RCLike.re_ofReal_pow, ...]`). `TestFunction.postcompCLE` (Postcomp.lean:44) is already generic over `𝕜`.
findings.fix: Restate it for `{𝕜} [RCLike 𝕜] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 V]` with `inner 𝕜`, and give `rieszEquiv` the same `𝕜` (Mathlib's `InnerProductSpace.toDual` is defined for any `RCLike 𝕜`). The `ℂ` uses then become instances of the general statements.
findings.issue: `eq_of_forall_integral_inner_eq` is stated for `[InnerProductSpace ℂ V]`, but the proof uses only `inner_sub_right`, `integral_re`, `inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K` and `RCLike.re`, all of which hold for any `RCLike 𝕜`. This rules out the real-valued case for no reason.

summary: Two generality problems: `HasNearDiagonalKernel.quantizeSchwartzValue_kernelCutoff_eq` assumes complex Hilbert coefficient spaces but uses no inner product, and `TestFunction.eq_of_forall_integral_inner_eq` is fixed to `ℂ` although its argument works for any `RCLike 𝕜`. The other new statements are at a sensible level.
